{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

df = trial_df.copy()

# Confirm the correct column name for response
print("Column names:", df.columns.tolist())

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute the fraction who responded
num_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
num_total = len(control_moderate)

fraction_responded = num_responded / num_total

print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE patients: {num_total}")
print(f"Number who responded: {num_responded}")
print(f"Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
